slides.title: Questions we get about the Morning Capacity Check
"I felt fine at 7 and flat by 10."
slides.body: Check in again. Adjust or stop. Both count.

slides.title: "What if every morning says rest?"
slides.body: Rest on purpose is fine. If the pattern worries you, talk to your doctor.

slides.title: "Does it work with my training plan?"
slides.body: Yes. It doesn't replace your plan. It helps you decide what fits today.

slides.title: "How long does it take?"
slides.body: About two minutes with the card.

slides.title: "Will it fix my sleep?"
slides.body: No. It's a way to decide about movement after a broken night.

slides.title: Want the whole method?
slides.body:
